printed_heading: REVENUES > Taxes (single row; Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, trimmed p5)
evidence: FY2022 p5 prints one 'Taxes' row; Economic Development column 507,211. Statement of Activities prints 'Local option sales taxes' 1,738,072; General Fund schedule prints 'City sales taxes' 723,650; 723,650 + 507,211 (Economic Development) + 507,211 (Street and Sidewalk Maintenance) = 1,738,072 exactly, so this column's Taxes is sales tax.

printed_heading: REVENUES > Taxes (single row; Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, trimmed p5)
evidence: FY2022 p5 prints one 'Taxes' row; Debt Service column 426,414. Local option sales taxes are fully used by General, Economic Development and Street columns; Statement of Activities 'Property taxes' 1,847,245 = General Fund schedule general property 1,103,299 + motor vehicle 128,384 + occupation 189,148 + Debt Service 426,414 exactly; the Debt Service Fund balance sheet (p4) also prints Cash at county treasurer and Taxes receivable. So this amount is property tax, not sales tax.
noticed: Statement of Activities 'Property taxes' total includes the General Fund motor vehicle and occupation taxes.
